column2:
Switched password managers last month.

Migration was annoying but worth it. The old one kept logging me out randomly.

Almost threw my laptop.

#Cybersecurity

Broke my monitor last week. Worked off laptop screen for 3 days.

Actually got more done?

Less tabs. Less distractions. Made me rethink my whole setup.

#HomeOffice

Two-factor authentication is annoying.

Until you get hacked.

Friend lost access to everything last month. One phishing email. Now he's a 2FA believer.

#Cybersecurity

Remote work confession: sometimes I answer Slack from bed before getting up.

It's either efficient or problematic.

Haven't decided which.

#WorkFromHome

Freelancer reality check:

Got paid today for work I did 60 days ago.

NET-60 terms are brutal.

Started being way pickier about payment terms in contracts.

#FreelanceLife

Bought a $40 webcam last week.

Laptop camera was making me look like a ghost in meetings.

Should've upgraded years ago. Clients can actually see my face now.

#RemoteWork

Keyboard died mid-deadline.

Scrambled to find my backup. Didn't have one. Borrowed from a neighbor.

Now I keep a spare.

Learn from my panic.

#RemoteWork

Time zone math is the worst part of remote work.

Had a call scheduled for 3pm. Their 3pm. My 10pm.

Showed up at MY 3pm like an idiot.

#RemoteWork

Paying $200/month for coworking. Went twice in November.

My apartment + noise-canceling headphones costs nothing.

Might be time to cancel.

#DigitalNomad

Tried using my phone as a second monitor today.

Works technically. Very small. Kept squinting.

Back to laptop screen like a normal person.

#RemoteWork

Invoice software saved my sanity.

Used to track everything in spreadsheets. Missed payments constantly.

Automated reminders changed everything. Clients actually pay on time now.

#FreelanceLife

Holiday reminder: backup your files before traveling.

Left my laptop on a train once. Had everything backed up.

Still lost the laptop but at least my work was safe.

#DigitalNomad

Year end is coming. Did you track your expenses?

I definitely did not for the first half of the year.

Spent yesterday going through bank statements.

Don't be me.

#FreelanceLife

Noise canceling headphones ranking after testing several:

1. Sony
2. Bose (close second)
3. AirPods Max (good but overpriced)

All three work well. Depends on your budget.

#RemoteWork

Best email marketing tool = whichever one you actually use.

Tried 3 this year. All do roughly the same thing.

Pick one and start building your list.

#FreelanceLife

New Year resolution for remote workers: set actual working hours.

I used to work until midnight randomly. Now I stop at 6pm.

Weekends exist again. Revolutionary concept.

#WorkLifeBalance

Wrapped up 2024 tool testing.

VPNs: clear winner.
Password managers: 2 solid options.
Project management: depends on team size.

Full reviews dropping January.

#Productivity

What kills your remote work productivity the most?

Genuinely curious—testing tools in all these categories right now.

Drop your answer.

#WorkFromHome
